correctness.rationale: Verified all zero-gap and tie cases. A factor with one marker is unbordered exactly when the marker is at an endpoint. For a candidate with both markers and unequal endpoint letters, 0^i 1 0^b 1 has a border exactly when i<=b; the other case is its reversal. This proves the maximum in both regimes. Summing over b and the maximum and minimum of the outer gaps gives the two rational terms. The uniform compositions converge by Riemann sums to the uniform simplex; the case boundary has measure zero. Inclusion–exclusion for the largest gap and the translated polygon of area (1-3s)^2/6 give the stated CDF; integrating its complement gives 20/27. The CDF clauses on either side of 1/2 are the same quadratic.
residual_risks: The finite replay corroborates rather than proves the universal and asymptotic results. The tail density 2 is unconditional; conditional on the tail it is 3.
